name: nmap
description: Comprehensive network port scanner with service version detection, OS fingerprinting, and NSE scripting engine for vulnerability detection and enumeration.

name: masscan
description: High-speed TCP port scanner capable of scanning large IP ranges at millions of packets per second for rapid attack surface discovery.

name: naabu
description: Fast port scanner with SYN and connect scanning modes, built-in nmap integration for automated service detection and fingerprinting.

name: rustscan
description: Extremely fast port scanner written in Rust that pipes results into nmap for detailed service enumeration and version detection.

name: dnsrecon
description: DNS enumeration tool supporting zone transfer attempts, reverse lookup, SRV record discovery, and brute-force subdomain scanning.

name: subfinder
description: Passive subdomain discovery tool that aggregates results from dozens of open-source intelligence sources and APIs.

name: amass
description: In-depth subdomain enumeration and attack surface mapping tool using passive OSINT sources, DNS brute-forcing, and graph analysis.

name: ffuf
description: Fast web fuzzer for directory discovery, parameter fuzzing, virtual host enumeration, and content discovery using customizable wordlists.

name: gobuster
description: Multi-purpose brute-force tool for directory and file discovery, DNS subdomain enumeration, and virtual host identification.

name: httpx
description: Multi-purpose HTTP probing tool for live host detection, technology fingerprinting, response analysis, and screenshot capture.

name: nuclei
description: Fast vulnerability scanner based on YAML templates with thousands of pre-built checks covering CVEs, misconfigurations, and exposures.

name: nikto
description: Web server vulnerability scanner that checks for outdated software, dangerous files, and misconfigurations across thousands of test items.

name: metasploit
description: Full-featured exploitation framework with thousands of modules for payload generation, vulnerability exploitation, and post-exploitation operations.
usage_guide: msfconsole -q -x 'use exploit/multi/handler; set PAYLOAD windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp; run'

name: sqlmap
description: Automated SQL injection detection and exploitation tool supporting all major database engines with advanced fingerprinting and data extraction.

name: hydra
description: Highly parallelised network login cracker supporting 50+ protocols including SSH, FTP, RDP, HTTP, SMB, Telnet, and databases.

name: responder
description: LLMNR, NBT-NS, and MDNS poisoner that captures NTLMv1/v2 hashes from local network segments for offline cracking or relay attacks.

name: impacket
description: Collection of Python classes for working with Windows network protocols including SMB, MSRPC, LDAP, and Kerberos with exploitation scripts.

name: hashcat
description: World's fastest GPU-accelerated password recovery tool supporting 300+ hash types with dictionary, brute-force, rule-based, and combinator attacks.

name: john
description: Multi-hash password cracker supporting traditional DES through modern bcrypt, scrypt, and Argon2 with wordlist and incremental modes.

name: burpsuite
description: Intercepting web proxy with repeater, intruder, scanner, and extensive extension ecosystem for manual and automated web application testing.
usage_guide: Configure browser proxy to 127.0.0.1:8080; use Repeater for manual request crafting

name: xsser
description: Automated cross-site scripting detection and exploitation framework supporting reflective, stored, DOM-based, and blind XSS vectors.

name: jwt_tool
description: JSON Web Token auditing and exploitation toolkit for testing token signing algorithms, key confusion, replay attacks, and payload tampering.

name: commix
description: Automated command injection testing tool for detecting and exploiting OS command injection vulnerabilities in web applications.

name: dirsearch
description: Advanced web path brute-forcer with recursive scanning, file extension filtering, and customizable HTTP request throttling.

name: wpscan
description: WordPress vulnerability scanner that enumerates plugins, themes, users, and known vulnerabilities from the WPScan vulnerability database.

name: jq
description: Lightweight, flexible command-line JSON processor for parsing, filtering, and transforming structured JSON data from tool outputs and APIs.

name: volatility
description: Advanced memory forensics framework for analysing kernel objects, processes, network connections, and injected code from RAM dumps.
usage_guide: volatility -f memory.dump imageinfo; volatility -f memory.dump --profile=<profile> pslist

name: binwalk
description: Firmware analysis tool for extracting filesystems, detecting embedded files, and identifying code signatures from binary images and firmware dumps.

name: wireshark
description: Network protocol analyser for deep inspection of live captures and pcap files, with protocol dissection, traffic filtering, and statistical analysis.

name: docker
description: Container platform for creating isolated sandbox environments to safely run tools, execute exploits, and validate PoCs without host system risk.

name: ansible
description: Automation framework for configuration management, application deployment, and infrastructure orchestration used for state verification and cleanup.

name: terraform
description: Infrastructure-as-code tool for provisioning and managing cloud resources, used to create and teardown ephemeral test infrastructure.

name: prowler
description: Multi-cloud security auditing tool for AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes with 300+ checks mapped to CIS benchmarks and compliance frameworks.

name: cloudsplaining
description: AWS IAM least-privilege analysis tool that identifies risky policies, over-permissive roles, and privilege escalation paths in cloud environments.

name: azurehound
description: Azure Active Directory enumeration tool that maps identity relationships and attack paths from Azure AD tenants using graph theory.

name: python
description: General-purpose programming language used for custom exploit scripts, payload construction, data parsing, and integration scripting across all stages.

name: curl
description: Versatile command-line HTTP client for request crafting, header inspection, response analysis, and API testing across all target types.

name: git
description: Distributed version control system used for repository reconnaissance, commit history analysis, exposed .git directory dumping, and code review.
usage_guide: git clone <repo>; git log --oneline; git diff <commit1>..<commit2>

name: openssl
description: Cryptography toolkit for TLS/SSL certificate inspection, TLS version testing, cipher suite validation, and cryptographic operation verification.
